Class BehaviorDelegate<T>

java.lang.Object
retrofit2.mock.BehaviorDelegate<T>
public final class BehaviorDelegate<T> extends Object
Applies behavior to responses and adapts them into the appropriate return type using the call adapters of Retrofit.
